verdicts.evidence: The right half is a flat pattern of drawn green ovals, with no fronds, real leaves or shaded setting, beside the headline "Ferns and shade plants for every corner".
The right part of the hero is plainly lighter, more saturated and busier than the dark left side, where the headline and button sit.
"Browse the greenhouse" is a thin white outline button with no fill, sitting on the busy green background below the subhead.
